02 / BEHIND THE FORMFROM A LINE TO A FEELING

Less accident.
More discovery.

These objects don't exist in a studio.
They emerge from curves, coordinates,
and a little deliberate curiosity.

FIG. 01 — A CONTINUOUS CURVE
01

Find the silhouette.

Each sculpture starts as a mathematical path. Curves are swept, twisted, and joined until the shape holds your attention from every angle.

PROCEDURAL GEOMETRY
02

Give it a surface.

Chrome bends the room around itself. Ceramic softens the edges. Glass lets one form become part of another. The material changes the conversation.

MATERIAL EXPLORATION
03

Let the light decide.

A narrow highlight reveals a twist. A shadow gives it weight. Carefully placed studio lights bring the geometry into focus.

LIGHT & COMPOSITION

An exploration.

FORM is an independent digital exhibition by Asifur Rahman Bhuiyan — a self-initiated exploration of sculpture, interaction, and the expressive possibilities of the web.

Three original procedural objects.
One small invitation to look a little longer.
